features: [Precisely Right] : With its 1600 DPI optical sensor, this mouse works on almost any surface with astounding accuracy. Stash it in your bag with your laptop and you'll be good to go
[Click real quick] : Get to clicking real quick with USB plug-and-play. It's as easy as opening the box.
[Looks good, feels good] : Elegant ergonomic design gives you all- day comfort so you can get it all done. It feels so natural, you'll forget you're holding it.
[Lefty or Righty] : Whether you're a righty, lefty, or bothy, this mouse is ready for however you click.
[Control the scroll] : Three buttons in one mouse. Left click, right click, or center click on the dual-function scroll wheel. You've got all the control you need in one fingertip
